1use std::ops::Range;
2use std::sync::LazyLock;
3
4use super::huffman::{self, HuffmanTable};
5use super::reader::Reader;
6use crate::third_party::hayro_cmap::CMapName;
7
8pub(super) static BUNDLE: LazyLock<Bundle> = LazyLock::new(|| {
9    // We already know the bundle is valid, so we can skip validation and just
10    // unwrap everywhere.
11
12    let compressed = include_bytes!("../../../../assets/vendor/hayro-cmap/assets/cmaps.brotli");
13    let mut decompressed = Vec::new();
14    let mut reader = compressed.as_slice();
15
16    brotli::BrotliDecompress(&mut reader, &mut decompressed).ok().unwrap();
17
18    let mut reader = Reader::new(&decompressed);
19    let huff_size = reader.read_u32().unwrap() as usize;
20    let huff_data = reader.read_bytes(huff_size).unwrap();
21    let (delta_table, count_table) = huffman::decode_tables(huff_data).unwrap();
22
23    let mut entries = Vec::new();
24
25    while !reader.at_end() {
26        let start = reader.position();
27
28        // Skip file magic and version.
29        reader.read_bytes(6).unwrap();
30        let file_len = reader.read_u32().unwrap() as usize;
31
32        reader.read_bytes(file_len - 10).unwrap();
33        entries.push(start..start + file_len);
34    }
35
36    Bundle { data: decompressed, delta_table, count_table, entries }
37});
38
39pub(super) struct Bundle {
40    data: Vec<u8>,
41    pub(super) delta_table: HuffmanTable,
42    pub(super) count_table: HuffmanTable,
43    entries: Vec<Range<usize>>,
44}
45
46/// Load the data for a cmap file, by name.
47pub fn load_embedded(name: CMapName<'_>) -> Option<&'static [u8]> {
48    // Get the index of the font of the cmap in the bundle. They are sorted
49    // alphabetically.
50    let idx = match name {
51        CMapName::N83pvRksjH => 0,
52        CMapName::N90msRksjH => 1,
53        CMapName::N90msRksjV => 2,
54        CMapName::N90mspRksjH => 3,
55        CMapName::N90mspRksjV => 4,
56        CMapName::N90pvRksjH => 5,
57        CMapName::AddRksjH => 6,
58        CMapName::AddRksjV => 7,
59        CMapName::AdobeCns1Ucs2 => 8,
60        CMapName::AdobeGb1Ucs2 => 9,
61        CMapName::AdobeJapan1Ucs2 => 10,
62        CMapName::AdobeKorea1Ucs2 => 11,
63        CMapName::B5pcH => 12,
64        CMapName::B5pcV => 13,
65        CMapName::CnsEucH => 14,
66        CMapName::CnsEucV => 15,
67        CMapName::ETenB5H => 16,
68        CMapName::ETenB5V => 17,
69        CMapName::ETenmsB5H => 18,
70        CMapName::ETenmsB5V => 19,
71        CMapName::EucH => 20,
72        CMapName::EucV => 21,
73        CMapName::ExtRksjH => 22,
74        CMapName::ExtRksjV => 23,
75        CMapName::GbEucH => 24,
76        CMapName::GbEucV => 25,
77        CMapName::GbkEucH => 26,
78        CMapName::GbkEucV => 27,
79        CMapName::Gbk2kH => 28,
80        CMapName::Gbk2kV => 29,
81        CMapName::GbkpEucH => 30,
82        CMapName::GbkpEucV => 31,
83        CMapName::GbpcEucH => 32,
84        CMapName::GbpcEucV => 33,
85        CMapName::H => 34,
86        CMapName::HKscsB5H => 35,
87        CMapName::HKscsB5V => 36,
88        CMapName::IdentityH => 37,
89        CMapName::IdentityV => 38,
90        CMapName::KscEucH => 39,
91        CMapName::KscEucV => 40,
92        CMapName::KscmsUhcH => 41,
93        CMapName::KscmsUhcHwH => 42,
94        CMapName::KscmsUhcHwV => 43,
95        CMapName::KscmsUhcV => 44,
96        CMapName::KscpcEucH => 45,
97        CMapName::UniCnsUcs2H => 46,
98        CMapName::UniCnsUcs2V => 47,
99        CMapName::UniCnsUtf16H => 48,
100        CMapName::UniCnsUtf16V => 49,
101        CMapName::UniGbUcs2H => 50,
102        CMapName::UniGbUcs2V => 51,
103        CMapName::UniGbUtf16H => 52,
104        CMapName::UniGbUtf16V => 53,
105        CMapName::UniJisUcs2H => 54,
106        CMapName::UniJisUcs2HwH => 55,
107        CMapName::UniJisUcs2HwV => 56,
108        CMapName::UniJisUcs2V => 57,
109        CMapName::UniJisUtf16H => 58,
110        CMapName::UniJisUtf16V => 59,
111        CMapName::UniKsUcs2H => 60,
112        CMapName::UniKsUcs2V => 61,
113        CMapName::UniKsUtf16H => 62,
114        CMapName::UniKsUtf16V => 63,
115        CMapName::V => 64,
116        CMapName::Custom(_) => return None,
117    };
118
119    let range = BUNDLE.entries.get(idx)?;
120
121    Some(&BUNDLE.data[range.clone()])
122}
